changes: Milestones: Your driver file keeps the special moments of your career: your first pole, your first win in the rain, your hundredth start, a win from tenth on the grid.
Career goals and a legacy: Pick three long-term goals, such as a title in every licence or making your team the best in the paddock, and see them judged in your yearbook.
Challenge levels and iron mode: Before a cup you can make it harder on purpose: stronger opponents, full damage, a start from the back, more rain or a double entry fee.
Drivers with a story: The regular drivers earn traits from what happens in your races, like a rain specialist after strong races in the wet or a slump after a run of weak cups.
Promises to team and sponsor: When a team or a season sponsor signs you, choose what you promise: a safe target, a normal one or an ambitious one with a bigger bonus.
Small things that help: Bookmark up to five cars at the dealer and see what you are still short of.
Weekly challenge: Every week one fixed challenge, the same for everyone: same circuit, same car, same conditions.
A lighter career: A Basic career for players who just want to race: licences, cups, prize money, dealers and your garage.
